summary: The AgentLoop Task Console implementation covers task CRUD, task list/detail data, lifecycle actions, config updates, artifacts, and agent runtime logs, with focused and full test suites passing. One required acceptance criterion remains unmet: local test command output is surfaced only as bounded log content, not as structured command, exit code, and duration fields required by AC-9.

comments.text: AC-9 requires the UI to show local test command output including command, exit code, duration, and log content. latest_runtime_summary currently returns each test as {name, log} from .agentloop/runs/<task_id>/<iteration>/tests/*.log, and renderRuntime displays the log path/content only. The command may be embedded in the log text, but exit code and duration are not exposed or rendered for test logs.
comments.required_action: Expose structured test result metadata for the latest iteration, including command, exit_code, duration_ms, and bounded log content, and update UI rendering/tests to assert those fields.

acceptance_results.evidence: Functional tests cover task list data, current-task marking, malformed task handling, and HTTP GET /api/tasks; source review confirms list renders id, title, status, phase, iteration progress, updated time, and current marker.
test_create_task_uses_workflow_artifacts and HTTP integration test verify POST /api/tasks creates a task through start_task and produces analysis.md, acceptance.md, and acceptance.json.

build_task_detail returns title/request, status, current phase, iteration/max_iterations, approval flag, phases, acceptance criteria, artifacts, config, actions, runtime, and errors; source review confirms UI detail tabs render these sections.
test_patch_config_and_delete_task and HTTP integration test verify max_iterations and test_commands persist to per-task config.json through validation-backed config patching.
test_patch_config_and_delete_task and HTTP integration test verify deletion requires exact confirmation, removes the task directory, and rejects incorrect confirmation.

test_actions_reflect_status verifies approve and run action availability changes by task status; source review confirms approve, run, cancel, delete, and config actions include enabled/reason states and lock handling.
Lifecycle mutation endpoints return fresh task detail, and the UI reloads task list/detail after approve/run/cancel; tests cover action state transition after approve.

test_detail_includes_artifacts_runtime_and_test_logs verifies latest runtime iteration and agent stdout content; source review confirms role, runtime, command, exit_code, duration_ms, artifacts, stdout, and stderr are returned and rendered for agent runtime entries.

The implementation reads latest test log files and displays bounded log content, but does not return or render structured command, exit_code, or duration_ms for local test commands. Existing tests only assert command text embedded in the log content.
Malformed state handling is tested; bounded_text caps artifact/log reads; missing agent logs return clear missing/error payloads; artifact paths are constrained.
tests/test_ui_api.py uses TemporaryDirectory workspaces and the executed focused suite passed with exit_code 0.

Manual source review of index.html/app.js/styles.css confirms the first screen is a task-management console with CRUD, lifecycle, progress, config, artifacts, and runtime output controls rather than a marketing page.

test_results.summary: Ran 6 tests; OK. Covered UI/API task list, creation, detail runtime/log data, config patching, deletion, action states, and HTTP/static endpoints.
Ran 56 tests; OK. Full repository test suite passed.
